text: On Friday, October 6, 2023, a young woman was struck by a vehicle while crossing at a mid-block cross walk on Brown's Line and Jellicoe Avenue and died of her injuries. Local residents have contacted my office to express safety concerns at this intersection, specifically regarding to this cross walk. I urge you to consider this request and support the implementation of road safety enhancements at the Brown's Line and Jellicoe Avenue intersection.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services to implement safety measures to increase pedestrian crossing safety at Brown's Line and Jellicoe Avenue.
